summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K on June 12, 2026, reporting positive 5-year (Week 266) data from its Phase 2 PaTH Forward Trial of TransCon PTH in adults with hypoparathyroidism. The filing contains no transaction, corporate action, or special situation—it solely communicates clinical trial results. The registrant is the issuer of this foreign private issuer report (equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K for material information). No deal terms, prices, premiums, or structural mechanics apply. What to watch: upcoming regulatory milestones for TransCon PTH; no risk-arb angle.
